test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I always believe that _______ is the best policy.
solution:
I always believe that '**honesty**' is the best policy.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**honesty**" is a noun that refers to the quality of being truthful and sincere.
 
• The sentence is a common phrase emphasizing that being honest is always the best approach.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and** 4** do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"I always believe that **honesty**__ is the best policy."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "complexity"** is incorrect because it refers to the state of being intricate or complicated, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 3: "immorality"** is incorrect as it refers to the quality of being immoral, which is contrary to the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 4: "sanctity"** is incorrect because it refers to the state of being holy or sacred, which does not match the context.
